beats.anchor: Dans son coin, même Jaden sourit.
beats.extras: Freddie Shaw, 14, the goalkeeper: a very tall, gangly white English boy (1.80 m) with copper red hair, freckles all the way up to his eyelids, ears turning red, extremely long arms, keeper gloves tucked under one arm, doubled up with laughter. Jaden Clarke, 15, number 4: a tall, athletic Black British boy with dark brown skin and close cropped black hair with a sharp hairline, sitting alone in the corner, the corner of his mouth lifting in a smile he is trying to hide. Four or five other teenage teammates of 14 and 15 on the benches, laughing, some white, some South Asian, some Black.
beats.outfit: Everyone in dark green Kingsbridge Albion tracksuits or the dark green kit with white sleeves. BriBri (13) with his red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, a few black rubber crumbs from the artificial pitch in his soft afro, the gap between his front teeth showing. Kaydoudou (14), the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: BriBri stands in the middle of the locker room imitating the coach: shoulders rolled forward, chest puffed out, both hands clapping hard, mouth wide open in a booming shout, eyebrows fierce. The teammates roar with laughter on the benches. Kaydoudou, sitting nearby, shakes his head with a grin. In the back corner, Jaden is smiling despite himself.
beats.location: A football academy locker room in south London: wooden benches, metal lockers, kit bags and boots on the floor, a whiteboard on the wall with two columns of tally marks and scribbles.
beats.light: Warm yellow ceiling light, steam on the window, a rainy evening outside.
beats.camera: Medium shot from bench height, BriBri in the centre, Freddie and the laughing boys on the left, Jaden small and sharp in the right background.
beats.alt: Dans le vestiaire, BriBri imite Coach Okafor et tout le monde rit, même Jaden dans son coin.

beats.anchor: Le bus passe dans le vide.
beats.extras: A fat grey London pigeon with a shiny green and purple neck, wings just opened, lifting off the road at the last second.
beats.outfit: BriBri (13) in a dark green Kingsbridge Albion tracksuit, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his soft afro, the gap between his front teeth. Kaydoudou (14) in the same dark green tracksuit, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Seen from the top deck front seat of a red double decker bus: BriBri presses his forehead and both palms against the big front window, eyes huge, mouth open in delight. Down on the wet road just in front of the bus, the pigeon has taken two small steps to the side and is flapping up and away as the bus rolls through the empty space. Kaydoudou, beside his brother, slowly turns his head toward him with a small, tired smile.
beats.location: A rainy south London high street at a traffic light: fried chicken shop fronts with blurred lit windows and no readable signs, bicycles, black umbrellas, shiny wet tarmac.
beats.light: Early evening, grey blue light, the street lamps and shop windows glowing warm through rain streaks on the glass.
beats.camera: Wide shot from just behind the two boys, over their shoulders, through the front window down onto the road and the pigeon taking off.
beats.alt: Du haut du bus rouge, BriBri voit un pigeon s'écarter au dernier moment : il a joué avant le contact.

beats.anchor: BriBri monte sur le banc, la médaille sur le cœur, et salue comme un roi.
beats.extras: Freddie Shaw, 14: very tall, gangly white English goalkeeper with copper red hair, freckles up to his eyelids, ears bright red with pride, conducting the room with both long arms like a choir master. Theo, a tall white English striker of 15 with short fair hair, and Arjun, a slim South Asian British playmaker of 14 with neat black hair, drumming on the lockers with the other laughing teammates.
beats.outfit: BriBri (13) in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion kit with white sleeves, his clean red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, a homemade medal on his chest: a round cardboard disc painted gold with marker, hanging from a ribbon of white goalkeeper tape, its writing shown only as scribbles. Kaydoudou (14) in the same kit with number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: BriBri stands on the wooden bench, chin high, one hand on the medal over his heart, the other arm sweeping out in a royal bow. Below him, Kaydoudou is bent over laughing out loud for the first time in weeks. Freddie conducts the anthem while the team bangs rhythmically on the metal lockers.
beats.location: The Kingsbridge Albion locker room after a match: muddy boots under the benches, open kit bags, steam rising, a whiteboard with tally marks.
beats.light: Warm yellow ceiling lights, steam catching the light, happy flushed faces.
beats.camera: Medium shot from slightly below, BriBri high in the centre like a king on a stage, Kaydoudou laughing in the lower right, Freddie on the left.
beats.alt: Debout sur le banc, la médaille en carton sur le cœur, BriBri salue comme un roi pendant que Kaydoudou rit aux éclats.
